q1: SELECT t1.player_name FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.height > 180 GROUP BY t1.id ORDER BY CAST(SUM(t2.heading_accuracy) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2."player_fifa_api_id") DESC LIMIT 10
q2: SELECT T1.player_name, AVG(T2.heading_accuracy) AS avg_heading_accuracy FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.height > 180 GROUP BY T1.player_api_id ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC LIMIT 10
